summary: Tested Claros Insights (Executive Command Center) end-to-end for principal@vaagdevi.edu.in. Backend pytest: 14/14 passed. Frontend: dashboard renders header, 12 KPI cards (students=20, departments=10, placed=9, placement_rate=45%), 3 chart SVGs, 7 NAAC progress rows (C1=79.2%, C5=78.3%), alert center, re-evaluate button (toast 'Evaluated 4 rules'), report generator producing markdown content with tenant 'Vaagdevi' plus Copy/Save buttons. Role gating verified: student sees insights-forbidden, sidebar-nav-insights hidden, all 6 student API calls return 403.

minor.issue: criterion_code returned as int (1..7) not 'C1'..'C7' as suggested in spec; frontend prefixes with 'C' for display. Either align backend to return code string or document as design choice.

avg_attendance_pct computes to 0.0% live because attendance_records are filtered by session_date >= 2026-01-01 (year_start) but seeded attendance data likely dates from 2025 — current year window discards them. Seeded alert event message shows 72% but live KPI shows 0%, creating a data inconsistency between Alert Center (72%) and KPI grid (0%).

ui_bugs.issue: Each KPI card's inner_text contains a leading '—' placeholder (likely the trend mini-sparkline fallback) alongside the real number. Visually small but signals stale/loading state when data is actually present.
Displays as '4LPA' without space/decimal (e.g., '4.0 LPA' or '₹4 LPA' is clearer).

Console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fired during initial render for chart-attendance/placements/enrollment. Charts still render correctly after layout settles, but the warnings indicate missing minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parent.

integration_issues.issue: Spec expects 'exactly 1 active alert' (the seeded Low Attendance Watch). After any /alerts/evaluate run, two more rules trigger because live KPIs breach thresholds (placement_rate=45% < 80% CRITICAL, naac_readiness_pct=32.2% < 70% WARNING). This is correct rule logic — but tests asserting 'exactly 1' will fail once evaluate is run. Consider not auto-evaluating on seed, or tightening seeded thresholds.

action_items: Investigate why live avg_attendance_pct=0% while seed event reports 72% — attendance_records session_date format/year window mismatch (seed appears to use 2025 dates, code filters by 2026 year_start).
Consider returning naac criterion_code prefixed with 'C' (e.g., 'C1') from backend for consistency with display.
Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial -1 width/height warnings by ensuring parent has explicit height or aspect prop.
Polish KPI card display: remove '—' placeholder in sparkline slot when no trend data; format avg package value (e.g., '4.0 LPA').
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_overview uses string-prefix regex on created_at (e.g. `^YYYY-MM-DD`) for ai_sessions_today — fragile if timestamps stored as datetime objects or with timezone offsets; recommend storing as proper ISO with consistent format and using $gte/$lt date bounds.

_coerce_iid for super_admin requires explicit iid query param but the dashboard fetches without iid — super_admin would get 400 on overview. Either default super_admin to first/known tenant or surface a tenant selector in UI.
Re-evaluate endpoint is admin-callable and unbounded — fine for now, but consider rate-limiting in production.
routes_insights.py is 600 lines and contains 7 KPI helpers + 8 routes — acceptable for now but watch growth; if/when reports/trends grow, split into routes_insights.py + insights_metrics.py.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 alert rule 'TEST_RULE_FeeFloor' via POST /api/v1/insights/alerts/rules during testing (idempotent, not cleaned up — minor leftover). After evaluate, 2 additional active alerts were triggered (placement CRITICAL, naac WARNING) in addition to seeded Low Attendance Watch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 14/14 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_claros_insights.py. Frontend: All UI sections work for VCE principal. Known data drift: avg_attendance_pct displays 0% while seeded alert says 72% — investigate attendance_records date filter. NAAC criterion_code returns ints; UI prefixes 'C'. Role gating fully working for student.
rca of the issue: Attendance 0% root cause: _compute_overview filters by session_date >= year_start_iso of current calendar year (2026-01-01). If seeded attendance_records have session_date <= 2025-12-31, they are excluded. Either backfill attendance records into 2026 or switch the window to a rolling-12-month definition for parity with the trend chart.
